posts.text: Upgraded the home server to SQLite 3.1 without breaking anything, which feels suspicious. Third attempt at pierogi today and it actually worked. My hedgehog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 75 pages. Packing list for the weekend trip is 61 items long and somehow still missing socks. Volunteering at the coffee shop on 5th this Saturday, come say hi if you are around. Reading A Psalm for the Wild-Built again and it hits differently this year. The cat next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating.
